major_risks.risk: Damage to the company's brand and reputation could hurt relationships with customers, associates, suppliers and others, and could hurt results and the stock price.
Strong competition, including from online and AI-enabled competitors, could reduce prices, margins, demand and market share.
The company may fail to identify and respond in time to changing customer needs, expectations and trends, which could hurt demand, inventory management and market share.
